Input: `OUTPUT/rds/spe_ruv.rds` (03)  
Output: Figure6ab in `OUTPUT/FIGURES/Main/Figure6`, source data 6a-6b in `OUTPUT/Excel Files/Main/Figure6`; `OUTPUT/TABLES/Figure6ab.xlsx`

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
source("Setup.R")
```

```{r}
spe_ruv <- readRDS(file.path(path_rds, "spe_ruv.rds"))
endometriosis <- c("Simple endometriosis", "Atypical endometriosis", "Cancer-like endometriosis")

keep <- spe_ruv$Segment == "CD68" & spe_ruv$Category %in% endometriosis
spe_sub <- spe_ruv[, keep]
dge <- spe_to_dge(spe_ruv)[, keep]
```

##### Differential expression
```{r}
design <- model.matrix(~0 + Category + ruv_W1 + ruv_W2 + ruv_W3, data = colData(spe_sub)) %>%
  tidy_design("Category")
contr.matrix <- makeContrasts(CLE_SE = Cancer_like_endometriosis - Simple_endometriosis,
                              AE_CLE = Cancer_like_endometriosis - Atypical_endometriosis,
                              levels = colnames(design))

efit <- fit_dge(dge, design, contr.matrix, block = factor(colData(spe_sub)$Patient))$efit

topTable_CLE_SE <- top_table(efit, "CLE_SE")
topTable_AE_CLE <- top_table(efit, "AE_CLE")
save_tables(list(CD68_CLE_SE = topTable_CLE_SE, CD68_CLE_AE = topTable_AE_CLE), "Figure6ab.xlsx")
```

##### Figure 6a-b
```{r, fig.width = 8.6, fig.height = 4}
# Macrophage genes are labelled from FDR < 0.2 and |log2FC| > 0.56
macrophage_genes <- c("CD68", "CD163", "CD14", "CSF1R", "FOLR2", "APOE", "HMOX1", "FN1", "FCGR3A", "EREG", "IL1B", "FOLR2", "LYVE1", "SELENOP",
                      "CD80", "CD86", "IL10RA", "C1QA1", "STAB1",
                      "CD115", "CD206", "PPARG", "ARG1", "CD163", "CD301", "PDL2",
                      "PDGFRA", "MFAP4")

v1 <- plot_volcano(topTable_CLE_SE, sig_genes_in(topTable_CLE_SE, macrophage_genes, fdr = 0.2, fc = 0.56),
                   col_low = "#20854EFF", col_high = "#EFC000FF", xlim = c(-8, 8), ylim = c(0, 8),
                   caption_x = 5.5, caption_y = 7, print_scale = 380 / 619,   # 8.6 in printed 380 pt wide
                   left = "SE", right = "CLE")
v2 <- plot_volcano(topTable_AE_CLE, sig_genes_in(topTable_AE_CLE, macrophage_genes, fdr = 0.2, fc = 0.56),
                   col_low = "#0073C2FF", col_high = "#EFC000FF", xlim = c(-8, 8), ylim = c(0, 8),
                   caption_x = 5.5, caption_y = 7, print_scale = 380 / 619,   # 8.6 in printed 380 pt wide
                   left = "AE", right = "CLE")
Figure6ab <- v1 + plot_spacer() + v2 + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 0.15, 1))  # gap between a and b
Figure6ab

save_plot(Figure6ab, "Figure6ab.svg", width = 8.6, height = 4)
save_source_data(volcano_source(v1), "Figure6a")
save_source_data(volcano_source(v2), "Figure6b")
```
